label: Juniper Heights, Day 41
summary: A suburban high school turned fortress, forty-one days after the dead started walking. Food is running low.

world.setting: Juniper Heights High School, fortified with buses and fencing, in a dead suburb
world.description: Nobody knows where the outbreak started. The turned are slow alone and terrible in crowds, and they follow noise. Sixty survivors have made Juniper Heights High a fortress: the gym is a dormitory, the science labs are the infirmary and the roof garden almost feeds everyone. Almost.
rules: The turned follow noise; quiet is life
Every supply run is a real risk, and not everyone comes back
People are the bigger danger: other groups want what you have
Small kindnesses and gallows humor keep people going

narration.tone: Desperate and human, with gallows humor
